notices.text:
All students appearing for placement assessments are hereby informed that their candidature will be verified exclusively against one of the following:

1. Original Physical Institute ID Card
2. Original Physical Institute Medical Book
3. Live Login to the ERP Profile

Candidates failing to produce at least one of the above-mentioned documents at the time of verification will be marked ABSENT on the attendance sheet and will not be permitted to proceed with the assessment.

Note: No alternative identification documents, including Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, EPIC/Voter ID, etc., will be accepted under any circumstances. Photocopies, scanned copies, and screenshots of institute credentials will also not be considered valid for verification.

All candidates are strictly advised to ensure that they carry at least one of the specified documents before reporting for their respective assessments.

CDC, IIT Kharagpur
